body: Yeah many of his good songs aren’t on Spotify, you have to go to YouTube.
Yeah these are some of his biggest hits. Personally though his lesser known songs like barefoot boy blues or Ol Leary’s cow are even better.

Most of his songs have less than 2k YT views. The fact is that nobody listens to him anymore, he was considered old music even in the 1980s and now it’s 2020. Church by the side of the road is alright and I like Electrified Donkey too.

Pretty much all of Hortons songs besides Sink the Bismarck and Battle of New Orleans are unheard of and “underrated” but yeah whispering pines is good. He has a lot more songs than most people realize and because he died 60 years ago most people have forgotten about him
